thinking.description: Thinking dashboard applied filters and presentation. All controls share one range; dates are half-open ISO bounds.

disclosures.description: Expanded content and settings sections by stable section/record identity; values are booleans. Transient menus and editor drafts are excluded.

find_regex.description: Page Find term is a JavaScript regular expression. Default off (literal).

history_collapsed.description: Collapsed History groups by displayed calendar date.

fixes_place.description: Filter fixes by where their prompt goes: global (the shared setup) or a stable repository target.

fixes_kind.description: Filter fixes by kind of fix; empty shows every kind.

fixes_rank.description: Order fix cards by priority (work items weighted down once quiet past the settings' bound, plus agent time lost), work items, latest occurrence, time lost, or repositories spanned.

fixes_hidden.description: Also list open fixes the settings' bounds hide (quiet too long, or too few work items), marked as hidden. Default off.

fixes_item.description: Open one fix by stable ID: its quotes with reader links, where the fix belongs, guidance matches and status.

safety_list.description: Risky action notice lifecycle. Copying a prompt moves selected notices to handed_off; dismissed is shown as Closed.

safety_place.description: Filter risky action notices by their stable repository, machine, or unresolved workspace target.

safety_rank.description: Order the risky action check cards by danger, latest activity, call count, or notices with new execution evidence. Ties use danger, then latest activity.

safety_case.description: Open a risky action notice by stable ID; evidence and source links live inside Details.

log_source.description: Settings → Logs source: overview (what to read first, and a report to copy for an agent), page (errors the page hit), requests (slow and failed requests, and those running now), service (this library's service output by run), app (the app's output by launch), background (failed or interrupted background work), crashes (macOS crash and resource reports).

average_fanout.note: Distinct direct child executions divided by their distinct recorded parents, including initiating agents and nested parents. delegating_run.note: One recorded parent execution, including initiating agents and nested parents, represented by its direct children's matching usage. AggOp.definition:
/** A single aggregate operation; only count needs no measure field. */
type AggOp = "count" | "count_distinct" | "sum" | "avg" | "min" | "max";

FilterOp.definition:
/** Filter operators. Every value can be NULL, so is_null/is_not_null are valid for every field type. */
type FilterOp = "=" | "!=" | ">" | ">=" | "<" | "<=" | "contains" | "starts_with" | "ends_with" | "matches_regex" | "not_matches_regex" | "length_gt" | "length_lt" | "length_eq" | "includes" | "is_null" | "is_not_null";

FitMode.definition:
/** Live column sizing mode; see `QueryState.fit`. */
type FitMode = "content" | "screen";

GroupKey.definition:
/** A field name (group by exact value) or a calendar key. */
type GroupKey = string | CalendarGroupKey;

ItemPropertyMode.definition:
/** Detail affordances are presentation state, never backend SELECT fields. */
type ItemPropertyMode = "hover" | "modal" | "expand";

RowId.definition:
/** A row's stable identity, used for selection and per-row refresh. */
type RowId = string | number;

WhereBranch.definition:
/** One alternative of an `OrOfAndsGroup`: a literal or a conjunction. */
type WhereBranch = WhereClause | WhereConjunction;

WhereClause.definition:
/** A single filter predicate (a "literal" in CNF terms). `value` is always the
 *  raw string the UI captured; coercion to number/bool/date happens at
 *  apply/compile time based on the field's declared type (never on the value's
 *  runtime shape). Datetime comparisons also accept signed duration offsets
 *  such as "-1h" or "+8d2h10m", resolved relative to execution time.
 *  Unused for the nullary ops (`is_null`/`is_not_null`).
 *
 *  `negated` wraps the predicate in a logical NOT. It is only ever set for ops
 *  that have no complementary operator (`contains`/`starts_with`/`ends_with`/
 *  `includes`); ops with a complement negate by flipping the op itself (`>=`→`<`,
 *  `=`→`!=`, `is_null`→`is_not_null`, `matches_regex`→`not_matches_regex`) — see
 *  `negateClause` in ops.ts. NOT is null-exclusive: a NULL/empty value satisfies
 *  neither the predicate nor its negation, matching `not_matches_regex`. */
interface WhereClause extends WireWhereClause {
    /** Presentation only; stripped before a request is sent. */
    setFilter?: SetFilterMetadata;
}
